data.body: Gerrit 2104 PS2: LLM-Review+1 PASS but Verified-1 on TWO REAL failures (not flakes): (1) test_schema_coverage[doctor] ModuleNotFoundError rebar_reconciler — doctor crashed in bare subprocess; my lazy reconciler import lacked the engine-dir sys.path bootstrap other engine-touching commands use. Fixed: added _ensure_engine_on_path() (engine ships as rebar core package data → portable). (2) test_user_guide_dc_docs env-only — my new mapping section's JIRA_PAT mention became the FIRST occurrence, pushing the env-only guarantee out of the test's 1200-char window; fixed by stating 'set in the environment (env-only, never a config key)' in my section. Both reproduced RED + now GREEN locally; lint/typecheck/wall-clock/oracle(13) all green. Amended PS3.
